external_interfaces.operating-system: Filesystem and stream bytes, clocks, environment, process and kernel resource observations are supplied by the registered OS interfaces. Every repository decision using them must be verified.
external_interfaces.git: The registered Git executable implements its documented object and command interfaces. Snapshot eligibility, identity comparisons, branch policy and lifecycle decisions remain repository proof obligations.
external_interfaces.cargo-rustc-verus-z3: The pinned Cargo/Rust compiler and Verus/Z3 toolchain implement their documented translation, erasure and verification interfaces. All repository build selection and proof-result decisions remain proof obligations.
external_interfaces.library-interfaces: Pinned third-party library interfaces are external assumptions only where explicitly used. Repository parsing policy, state transitions and error handling remain proof obligations; this list grants no external_body exception to repository functions.
external_interfaces.verus-vstd-and-macros: The matching pinned Verus standard-library interface specifications and macro erasure implement the documented Rust primitive/container semantics. This trusts external library contracts; it does not exempt repository callers or their invariants.
external_interfaces.verus-package-distribution: The fixed official GitHub release URL supplies archive bytes over HTTPS through /usr/bin/curl; /usr/bin/shasum implements SHA-256 checking and /usr/bin/tar implements BSD archive extraction and the explicitly registered path substitution. Repository selection, ordering, failure handling, source and installation admission remain proof obligations.
